payload.next_action: CCAS-P0-06 Pre-Implementation Design Review is PASS on ContentAuthoringSystemPlan.md v0.1.12. Implementation is READY but remains NOT OPENED until the USER explicitly instructs implementation. When opened, implement only the frozen P0-06 planning/review layer: whole-Catalog SnapshotFingerprint, typed PlanningMetadata, Active/Deprecated/Retired lifecycle, snapshot-aware semantic Change Set preflight, per-record rationale + immutable ReviewPackageFingerprint, two-layer stale guard, and exact no-direct-DataAsset-write tests. Preserve P0-01~05 accepted Core/Compiler/Provider behavior. Do not open Workbook/DataAsset Product authoring, Provider.ApplyReviewed Product mutation, Product Apply/Save, physical rename/move/delete, or P0-07 authority cutover.

provenance.resolution_basis: CCAS-P0-06 blocking P1 exact6 from the prior design HOLD were corrected with minimal contracts in ContentAuthoringSystemPlan.md v0.1.12 and freshly re-reviewed. P1-1 freezes whole registered Catalog SnapshotFingerprint as the immutable planning authority without a separate random snapshot identity. P1-2 preserves the USER Accepted Weapon Roster planning fields through typed PlanningMetadata while separating planning readiness from Product Apply authority. P1-3 adds explicit Active/Deprecated/Retired lifecycle semantics and keeps physical row removal separate from Retire and Product delete. P1-4 keeps existing ChangeSet shape validation and adds snapshot-aware semantic preflight/conflict rejection without a per-operation revision framework. P1-5 freezes per-record rationale and Change Set exact1 approval bound to immutable ReviewPackageFingerprint, with partial approval out of P0 scope. P1-6 freezes BaseWorkbookSemanticHash plus BaseCatalogSnapshotFingerprint as a two-layer stale guard and requires fresh replan rather than automatic rebase/retry. Fresh re-review result: P0 exact0, blocking P1 exact0, P2 exact3 non-blocking, Design PASS. Existing P0-01~05 implementation remains preserved. Implementation, Workbook/DataAsset authoring, Product Apply/Save and P0-07 cutover remain unopened.
